facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2026-2029 budget guidelines mandate that Regional Coordinating Councils and MMDAs process all financial transactions through GIFMIS, under the PFM Act 2016 (published date 2025-08-29 used, as the document gives no other).
facts.system: GIFMIS (Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System)
